name: Fort Wolcott
text: Fort Wolcott was a fortification on the small Goat Island in Newport Harbor of Narragansett Bay less than 1 mile west of the city of Newport, Rhode Island. The attacks on HMS St John and HMS Liberty occurred near the fort.

depictions.name: Fort Wolcott
depictions.text: the memory of the same name from Assassin's Creed III Fort Wolcott was a fortification located on Goat Island, having been built to protect the nearby town of Newport, Rhode Island. Throughout history, it underwent several renames.
